notes: Table 3.1 includes backlog students; Table 3.2 excludes them (Chapter 3 introduction, PDF page 1). The two are not directly comparable: 3.1(a) grand total 164801 vs 3.2 total 148027.
Table 3.1(a) lists Sripalee Campus (letter S) and Trincomalee Campus (letter W) as separate blocks; Table 3.2 folds them into University of Colombo and Eastern University (footnote 2).

Institution and faculty names are as printed, including the source's spelling (e.g. 'Eastern University, Sri lanka', 'Humanaties & Social Science', 'Computing & Technoogy', 'Performing Art'); only repeated spaces were collapsed (e.g. 'South Eastern University of  Sri Lanka'). Table 3.2 names spread over two printed lines are joined.

In 3.1(a), University of Colombo School of Computing and Swami Vipulananda Institute of Aesthetic Studies print a second, unlabelled subtotal equal to the institution total (no faculty heading); it is not repeated as a field row.

Open University of Sri Lanka, Institute of Human Resource Advancement, 'Foreign Qualification', 'Lateral Entry' and 'Institute of Indigenous Medicine' have no ZedPath letter in data/ugc/2025-2026/unicodes.csv, so letter is null.
Table 3.2 'Institute of Indigenous Medicine(6)' prints a 2022 value only (2023 and 2024 blank) and is therefore not in rows.

Table 3.2 footnotes as printed: (1) Excluding Open University as it shows separately under Table 03 - 04. (2) University of Colombo includes Sripalee Campus while Eastern University includes Trincomalee Campus too. (3) This excludes backlog students 15290 in 2022, 20467 in 2023 and 17607 in 2024. (4) This includes foreign and lateral entry too. (5) Faculty of Livestock, Fisheries & Nutrition of Wayamba University includes in Agriculture stream too. (6) Institute of Indigenous Medicine became a Faculty of the University of Colombo in 2023.

Table 3.2 'field' values are the UGC's programme columns (Arts, Management & Commerce, Law, Medicine, Dental Science, Veterinary Science, Agriculture, Engineering, Architecture & Quantity Surveying, Computer Science, Allied Health Sciences, Science, Indigenous Medicine, Technology); they are a grouping, not the faculty headings used in 3.1(a).

Verification: every 3.1 figure satisfies male + female = total; each institution total equals the sum of its faculties, each faculty the sum of its degree programmes, each programme the sum of its intake-year lines; institution totals sum to the printed grand totals (164801; 32408). Every 3.2 row sums to its Total column and every column sums to the printed Total row for 2022, 2023 and 2024. All extracted figures and names were re-read with a second PDF text extractor and matched.

Not extracted: postgraduate tables 3.3(a)/(b) (separate tables by academic programme; no per-university postgraduate total inside 3.1 or 3.2), Open University level-on-roll tables 3.4(a)-(c), Institute tables 3.5(a)/(b), external degree programmes table 3.6, and charts 07-10.
